story_checkpoint.summary: The Ramsay family and their guests are at their summer house in the Hebrides. James longs to visit the lighthouse. Mrs. Ramsay keeps his hope alive, while Mr. Ramsay insists that the weather will prevent the trip. The visit has not happened yet. Lily Briscoe is working on a painting of Mrs. Ramsay and James and struggling to express what she sees. Attention moves between the characters' private thoughts: Mrs. Ramsay cares for the family and guests, and Mr. Ramsay's need for recognition strains their relationships.
